name: multiplayer-choicer-voicer
description: Multiplayer Choicer Voicer: dub Choicer Voicer packs together in the browser.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names server,web --prefix-colors yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @mcv/server" "npm run dev -w @mcv/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mcv/server && npm run build -w @mcv/web
